name: Combo chart
purpose: Bars on a PRIMARY axis + a line on a SECONDARY axis — two related measures in DIFFERENT UNITS over one shared x (dv-line-006: dual axes only for different measurement units, clearly labelled, key states which axis each series reads against). NET-NEW type (chart-revisit wave lane 3, 2026-07-24 — Dave: 'we've completely missed the bar with line overlay'); no proforma precedent, designed to the method: semantic SVG styled by tokens, decorative motion by CSS, behaviour by the ADR-0015 generated JS partial (dv-behaviour — UNREGISTERED until conductor absorb; markers are an empty pair), described by ONE real table carrying both series with unit columns.

props.name: series
props.$note: Exactly TWO: bars = data/series/1 (DV-D09 column default) on the left/primary axis, line = data/series/2 on the right/secondary axis. More bar series (grouped combo) is a future variant — grouped promote rides the bar lane (D-Q3).

props.name: secondaryAxis
props.$note: THE COMBO PRECEDENT: bar axis zero-based ALWAYS (dv-bar-009, data-domain-min="0"); the line's secondary axis MAY FLOAT (dv-line-001 — zero optional where it aids interpretation) and shows its FULL tick run with the unit suffix baked into the tick text ('85%' … '100%') so the floating floor is explicit, never silent. Right-edge rule renders in the data/axis role (quieter than the ink baseline — the overlaid scale is chrome, not the plot floor).

props.name: intersection
props.$note: Line-vs-bar direct contrast is 1.04:1 — the categorical set is isoluminant BY DESIGN, so no series pair separates a crossing. The line carries a PAGE-COLOUR CASING (.dv-casing, 6.5px page stroke under the 2.5px series stroke — the marker halation idiom generalised): every crossing boundary reads at page-vs-bar-fill = the bar's own gate-checked ≥3:1, both modes, high-contrast included. The casing is NOT class dv-series (the gate must never contrast-check page-vs-page) and carries data-series-group="2" so filter/isolate/highlight take it with its line.

props.name: xGrammar
props.$note: BAND CENTRES — bar convention wins the shared x-axis: 12 bands across the 522px plot, bars centred in bands (width 28), line points ride the SAME centres so every point sits over its bar. Chart-line's endpoint spread (f=i/11) does not compose with bars.

props.name: data
props.$note: ONE real <table class="dv-table"> (dv-005) carries BOTH series with unit column headers (Payments £000 · STP rate %); popover tips read the same values; † flags at/above target.

props.name: target
props.$note: Target overlay on the SECONDARY scale (dashed data/target line + label), governed by a single-cell seg toggle (Dave 2026-07-24 construction). Demonstrates overlays against the floating axis.

props.name: title
props.$note: Optional visible title slot (.dv-title, dv-006) — t-cm-section-label; sr-only figcaption always names the chart.

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: combo
variants.use: Volume-style bars + a rate/average line in a different unit (e.g. payments processed + straight-through rate). NOT for two same-unit series — that is a multi-series line or grouped bar.

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — DV-D08 ladder: axis ticks (both axes, suffixed) .t-cm-chart-value (12/500 tabular) · month labels + legend + controls .t-cm-chart-label (12/500) · letter keys .t-cm-chart-key (12/700); table .t-cm-legal; title .t-cm-section-label
tokens.series: data/series/1 (bars) + data/series/2 (line) + high-contrast pair; axis/grid/target = the DV-D07 two-channel roles (colour + alpha slot); casing + marker strokes = background/default (page)
tokens.surfaces: popovers/table panel = background/default + elevation/functional shadow + elevation/border (dark outline); radius = border-radius/surface role token

motion.entry: Bars grow from the baseline (760ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), 45ms stagger — Chart-bar language); line + casing draw AS ONE (same pathLength=2400 + 2400ms draw — the casing must never lead its line); markers land on the eased cadence (0·369·507·…·2400ms); the letter key fades in as the draw completes. All CSS (DEF-003).
motion.hover: Bar brightness emphasis (1.12 light / 1.22 dark); legend/marker hover-highlight dims the OTHER series' data layer to .25 (.dv-quiet).

responsive.rule: DV-D02 + fit via the behaviour partial: baked-fraction relayout (bars data-fx/data-fw, line data-fxs/data-ys, markers data-fx/data-x0, BOTH axes' ticks data-fx/data-dx) to the container width — fixed height, TEXT NEVER SCALES (viewBox pinned 1:1). Both scales recompute under fit because both are baked fractions of the same plot frame (46/12/260). JS-off = static 580×260 + horizontal scroll; stage padding-right 32px keeps the suffixed right ticks + letter key visible at the clip edge.

mustNotNeighbour: A second chart re-using these series colours for DIFFERENT data in the same journey (dv-014)
A same-unit pair drawn as a combo (use multi-series line or grouped bar instead — dv-line-006)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption (names BOTH units and axes); svg role="group" + full-sentence aria-label; table panel role="region".
accessibility.name: Bars AND markers are focus stops (tabindex 0) with aria-label == data-tip == table values; the legend text names each series' axis and unit (dv-line-006 — never colour alone: shapes + letters + axis-named legend).
accessibility.keyboard: Bars + markers = focus stops (popover on focus); legend rows = filter buttons (aria-pressed; Shift+Enter isolates); table toggle aria-controls/expanded, Esc dismisses + refocuses; target toggle aria-pressed.

antiPatterns: Dual axes for the SAME unit (dv-line-006 — different measurement units only)
A floating bar axis (dv-bar-009 — bars are zero-based, only the line axis may float)
The line crossing bars without its page casing (isoluminant series ≈1:1 at the boundary)
A second gridline set for the secondary axis (grid follows the primary; the right rule + suffixed ticks carry the secondary scale)
Colour as the only channel (shapes + letters + axis-named legend, always)
